children: Runway Growth Finance entered into an underwriting agreement for a $45.0 million issuance of 7.75% Notes due 2031. The deal includes a 30-day option for underwriters to purchase up to an additional $6.8 million to cover overallotments. Closing is expected on Oct 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions, under the company's effective shelf registration. Oppenheimer is acting as representative of the underwriters.
: Runway Growth Capital and Oppenheimer, as representative of the underwriters
: Raise debt capital via 7.75% notes issuance
